thesis: ADMA is a profitable, cash-generative biotech in a post-earnings uptrend (close above SMA20, SMA50 and SMA200) that is pulling back into its entry zone after a rejection at 14.2. Q3 results and reaffirmed guidance produced a heavy-volume gap that has held, with higher lows since, which points to post-earnings drift and not a one-day spike. Fundamentals are high quality with low dilution risk and a fair valuation, and healthcare is one of the leading defensive sectors in a risk-off tape. The weak points are the hostile regime, small insider sales, and a target that needs a break of 14.2 first, so this only supports a small-size swing long with a tight stop.
